approved_command_preview: Issue #380 first evidence pass: compare #382 baseline workflow inventory/contracts to current main with expected relocation paths normalized, run workflow maintenance audits from a real checkout, and write artifact readback files. No source edits or workflow dispatches.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repo = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('DCOIR_REPO_ROOT','Machine')
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($repo)) { $repo = (Get-Location).Path }
Set-Location $repo
$outRoot = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('DCOIR_DOWNLOADS_DIR','Machine')
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($outRoot)) { $outRoot = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dcoir_issue380' }
$out = Join-Path $outRoot 'issue380-workflow-regression-001'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null
$baseline = '9ee771c2a885bd95075fb19acdc80991877c6cf3'
$requestHead = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$current = $requestHead
try {
  $parent = (git rev-parse "$requestHead^" ).Trim()
  $changed = @(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r $requestHead)
  if (($changed.Count -eq 1) -and ($changed[0] -like '.github/chatgpt_staging/exec_requests/*.json')) { $current = $parent }
} catch { }
function Show-File([string]$Ref, [string]$Path) { git show "${Ref}:$Path" | Out-String }
function Normalize-RelocationText([string]$Text) {
  $pairs = @(
    @('.github/scripts/chatgpt_apply_in','tools/chatgpt_apply_in'),
    @('.github/scripts/chatgpt_stage_out','tools/chatgpt_stage_out'),
    @('.github/dcoir_review/scripts','scripts'),
    @('.github/dcoir_review/prompts','prompts'),
    @('.github/dcoir_review/schemas','schemas'),
    @('.github/chatgpt_staging','chatgpt_staging'),
    @('.github/github_actions','project_sources/github_actions'),
    @('.github/operator_tools','operator_tools'),
    @('.github/ops','ops')
  )
  $value = $Text -replace "`r`n", "`n"
  foreach ($pair in $pairs) { $value = $value.Replace($pair[0], $pair[1]) }
  return $value.Trim()
}
function Compare-Normalized([string]$Name, [string]$BasePath, [string]$CurrentPath) {
  $baseText = Normalize-RelocationText (Show-File $baseline $BasePath)
  $currentText = Normalize-RelocationText (Show-File $current $CurrentPath)
  $baseOut = Join-Path $out "$Name.baseline.normalized.txt"
  $currentOut = Join-Path $out "$Name.current.normalized.txt"
  $diffOut = Join-Path $out "$Name.normalized.diff.txt"
  $baseText | Out-File -FilePath $baseOut -Encoding utf8
  $currentText | Out-File -FilePath $currentOut -Encoding utf8
  if ($baseText -eq $currentText) {
    "No normalized diff." | Out-File -FilePath $diffOut -Encoding utf8
    return $true
  }
  git diff --no-index --no-color -- $baseOut $currentOut > $diffOut 2>&1
  return $false
}
$results = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$failed = $false
function Run-Step([string]$Name, [string]$CommandLine, [bool]$Optional = $false) {
  $log = Join-Path $out "$Name.log"
  "PS> $CommandLine" | Out-File -FilePath $log -Encoding utf8
  cmd /d /c $CommandLine >> $log 2>&1
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  $results.Add([ordered]@{ name = $Name; exit_code = $code; optional = $Optional; log = (Split-Path -Leaf $log) })
  if (($code -ne 0) -and (-not $Optional)) { $script:failed = $true }
}
$inventoryParity = Compare-Normalized 'workflow_inventory_json' 'project_sources/github_actions/workflow_inventory.json' '.github/github_actions/workflow_inventory.json'
$contractParity = Compare-Normalized 'workflow_modularization_contracts_json' 'project_sources/github_actions/workflow_modularization_contracts.json' '.github/github_actions/workflow_modularization_contracts.json'
git diff --name-status $baseline $current -- .github/workflows .github/actions .github/github_actions project_sources/github_actions chatgpt_staging .github/chatgpt_staging ops .github/ops operator_tools .github/operator_tools tools .github/scripts scripts prompts schemas .github/dcoir_review | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'baseline-to-current-name-status.txt') -Encoding utf8
git ls-tree -r --name-only $baseline .github/workflows .github/actions project_sources/github_actions | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'baseline-workflow-surfaces.txt') -Encoding utf8
git ls-tree -r --name-only $current .github/workflows .github/actions .github/github_actions | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'current-workflow-surfaces.txt') -Encoding utf8
Run-Step 'check_workflow_action_versions' 'python .github/github_actions/tools/check_workflow_action_versions.py'
Run-Step 'check_workflow_consistency_drift' 'python .github/github_actions/tools/check_workflow_consistency_drift.py'
Run-Step 'build_workflow_inventory_check' 'python .github/github_actions/tools/build_workflow_inventory.py --check'
Run-Step 'check_workflow_modularization_contracts' 'python .github/github_actions/tools/check_workflow_modularization_contracts.py'
Run-Step 'audit_reusable_contracts' 'python .github/github_actions/tools/audit_reusable_contracts.py'
$token = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('DCOIR_GITHUB_FG_TOKEN','Machine')
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($token)) { $token = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('DCOIR_GITHUB_CL_TOKEN','Machine') }
if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($token)) { $env:GH_TOKEN = $token }
Run-Step 'latest_workflow_maintenance_audit_runs' 'gh run list --workflow workflow-maintenance-audit.yml --branch main --limit 5 --json databaseId,workflowName,event,status,conclusion,headSha,createdAt,updatedAt,url' $true
Run-Step 'latest_scheduled_health_check_runs' 'gh run list --workflow scheduled-health-check.yml --branch main --limit 5 --json databaseId,workflowName,event,status,conclusion,headSha,createdAt,updatedAt,url' $true
$summary = [ordered]@{
  request_id = 'exec-20260713-issue380-regression-001'
  issue = 380
  baseline_ref = $baseline
  request_head_sha = $requestHead
  evaluated_current_ref = $current
  normalized_inventory_parity = $inventoryParity
  normalized_contract_parity = $contractParity
  command_results = @($results)
}
$summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50 | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'issue380-regression-summary.json') -Encoding utf8
@(
  '# Issue #380 workflow regression evidence',
  '',
  "- baseline_ref: $baseline",
  "- request_head_sha: $requestHead",
  "- evaluated_current_ref: $current",
  "- normalized_inventory_parity: $inventoryParity",
  "- normalized_contract_parity: $contractParity",
  '',
  '## Command results'
) | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'issue380-regression-summary.md') -Encoding utf8
foreach ($result in $results) { "- $($result.name): exit $($result.exit_code) -> $($result.log)" | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'issue380-regression-summary.md') -Encoding utf8 -Append }
if ((-not $inventoryParity) -or (-not $contractParity) -or $failed) { exit 1 }
exit 0
